role: The 1.7.10 chunk mesher core: loads the oracle's probe directory (manifest.json, table.bin, atlas.json, chunks.bin, tileentities.bin), ports Tessellator's 8-int vertex format and RenderBlocks' shared machinery (icons, ChunkCache light, biome colours, shouldSideBeRendered, the six face renderers, the standard-block AO/partial/colour paths, crossed squares, fluids, logs, double plants) and the render-type dispatch that WorldRenderer.updateRenderer drives per section and pass.

structs.name: rb_table
structs.java: table.bin: Block.getIcon(side, meta) for every block, render properties, setBlockBoundsBasedOnState bounds, ColorizerGrass/ColorizerFoliage colormaps, BiomeGenBase colour data, MathHelper.SIN_TABLE

structs.name: rb_props
structs.java: per-block Block.canBlockGrass, renderAsNormalBlock, useNeighborBrightness, getRenderBlockPass, isOpaqueCube, BlockSlab, getLightValue, getAmbientOcclusionLightValue

structs.name: rb_biome
structs.java: BiomeGenBase temperature, rainfall, waterColorMultiplier and the grass/foliage colour kind (map, roofed forest, swamp, constant, mutated)

structs.name: rb_atlas
structs.java: TextureMap sprites: IIcon name to minU/maxU/minV/maxV

structs.name: rb_world
structs.java: ChunkCache over the chunks the oracle meshed, plus the tile entities the mesher reads

structs.name: rb_tess
structs.java: Tessellator (rawBuffer, vertexCount, textureU/V, xOffset/yOffset/zOffset, color, brightness, normal, hasTexture/hasColor/hasBrightness/hasNormals) plus a per-vertex debug tag

structs.name: rb_mesher
structs.java: RenderBlocks instance state: renderMinX..renderMaxZ, partialRenderBounds, enableAO, renderAllFaces, renderFromInside, flipTexture, field_152631_f, uvRotate*, overrideBlockTexture, the colour/brightness corner fields and the aoLight*/aoBrightness* neighbour fields; plus BlockAnvil.field_149833_b and BlockPistonBase's stored bounds

notes: Frame-side, not in the server or client tick, except rb_foliage_color_multiplier which particles_live.c calls when a digging particle spawns in the live client. Unported render types fall to a stderr notice in render_block's default case (render types 22 chest and 255 skull draw nothing, as in vanilla). The meshes are gated against the oracle's MeshProbe dumps in out/java/meshes (mesh-s1, mesh-s42, scene-2, scene-42, scene3-2, scene3-2-fast, scene3-42) by test_meshes.c; which dumps the gate currently runs was not verified. Also consumed by raster.c, block_item_model.c (with a NULL world), particles_live.c, raster_worldfx.c and csrc/play/play.c. The gpu line numbers for the loader mallocs are approximate ranges. rb_world has two forms: chunks.bin's byte records (the render gates) and, with chunks set, a window of struct chunk records (play's live renderer, lane/gpumem), which the rb_world_* accessors read the same way; an empty slot reads as a record of zeros. The device mesher (csrc/cuda/meshing, mirror.tsv MESH) compiles this file, render_blocks2.c and render_blocks3.c for the GPU as they are: it walks rb_mesh_section's cells through rb_mesh_section_begin, rb_mesh_cell_kind and rb_mesh_cell, a Tessellator without a buffer counts vertices, and libm's cos, sin and atan2 go through rb_cos, rb_sin and rb_atan2 (the host's values, which the rb_trig_* functions list). On the device (cuda/meshing, __NVPTX__) rb_world_block, rb_world_meta and saved_light first look the cell's band up in rb_world's band table (band_of: one load where chunk_in, the band offset and the mask took three dependent loads), the same answers; outside the table, or a section the mask leaves out in the light's case, they take the host path (lane/meshkern). rb_mesh_cell_standard is rb_mesh_cell for a hidden cube or a render type 0 block (rb_mesh_cell calls it for those): the device's cube kernels (mesh_draw_cube, mesh_run_cube) call it directly, so their code reaches renderStandardBlock alone (lane/meshsplit). The device's band_of tests the cell against the band table's first block in x, y and z (rb_world band_x0, band_y0, band_z0, set with the table), one unsigned compare an axis (lane/meshgpu). rb_mesh_guess_cell (device only) is render_block_begin, the device mesher's guess of the words a cell's draw leaves (cuda/meshing kernels.c guess_as; render_blocks2.c's rb2_stairs_state, rb2_door_state and rb2_fence_state add their last part's bounds), held there against the lane before's end. The block class table (block_class_of, rb_block_class for the other files) also marks BlockAnvil and BlockPistonBase, which rb3_block_icon_index tests instead of comparing class names on every face (lane/meshgpu).
